subject: general
question: In November 2019 the NITI Aayog has released a Draft Model Act on Land ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**titling.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The NITI Aayog the draft model Act and rules for states for **regulation on conclusive land titling.**
 
• It provides for a state government to order establishment of title registration for all or any type of immovable properties.
 
• The model Act and rules will provide state governments power to order for establishment, administration and management of a system of title registration of immovable properties.
 
• The model Act and rules will provide state governments power to order** for establishment, administration and management of a system of title registration of immovable properties.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• NITI Aayog: 

 
 
• NITI Aayog is not a constitutional body.
 
• It was established on January 1, 2015.
 
• It is formed in place of the Planning Commission.
 
• The ex-officio president of this is the Prime Minister.
 
• It is the premier policy ‘Think Tank’ of the Government of India, providing both directional and policy inputs.
 
• **Headquarters**: New Delhi
